definitions.sample: Completed regular-season games before the target week; run/pass plays, no_play excluded; finite EPA required.
definitions.epa: Mean source EPA per eligible play. Positive defense EPA allowed favors the opposing offense.
definitions.success: Source success flag; EPA > 0 only where that flag is missing.
definitions.recent: 60% season rate + 40% last four prior games when all four are available; recent games are also in the season sample.
definitions.explosive: Season-only rate: pass gain >= 20 yards; run gain >= 10 yards.
definitions.volume: Season-only eligible run/pass plays per completed game, excluding no-plays and plays without finite EPA.
definitions.turnovers_sacks: Season-only interceptions/lost fumbles and sacks on eligible plays, divided by games.
definitions.qb_split: Team offense in games where the named QB owns at least 80% of identified pass plays and at least 10 passes. This is a game-level split, not a causal QB effect.
definitions.audit: Independent pandas aggregation of the same nflverse source. Reconciliation does not mean independent external verification or predictive calibration.
